source_document.document_version: Amended Clinical Trial Protocol 05, Version number: 1

extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Single-pass extraction of Section 1.3 SCHEDULE OF ACTIVITIES (SOA), document pages 18-21 (PDF pages 1-4), page numbering per PAGEMAP.md (printed footers read one lower than the document page). Text layer is clean (not glyph-spread); marks and cell text read with pdftotext -bbox, cell/merge geometry recovered from 200 dpi raster rule lines (prompt s1d) and validated cell-for-cell against rendered crops of pages 18, 19, 20 and 21. One label column (Evaluation), so the first data column is position 2 and the ten schedule columns run 2-11; the right-hand Notes column is source column 12 and is excluded from schedule_grid/activity_schedule, its contents emitted as annotations. Grey cell shading (not-applicable cells) was treated as formatting and left as empty cells. Doc pages 22-24 of the excerpt (PK/immunogenicity and exploratory biomarker flow charts) fall beyond the declared SoA range and are not extracted - see the uncertainty report.

table_metadata.table_purpose: Primary activity x timepoint schedule for the whole study: Screening, Treatment Phase (Cycle 1 by day, Cycle 2 and Beyond), End of Treatment, and Post Treatment Follow-up (safety and survival).
table_metadata.notes: Classified main_soa: it is the protocol's primary anchor grid (Section 1.3) and every other schedule content in the excerpt refers back to it. The table prints across four document pages (18-21) with an identical header block reprinted on each page and the body rows simply continuing; it is emitted as ONE table with page_start 18 / page_end 21 rather than a parent plus three continuation tables, so that the footnotes a/b/c - whose markers and definitions sit on different pages - stay resolvable within one table. Header block is three stacked rows (phase / cycle-period / study day); the label column of that block carries only 'Evaluation' merged vertically over all three rows, so all three property names are synthesized. Row 2 columns 2-3 are blank because the row 1 'Screening' cell is merged vertically into row 2 (the schema has no vertical merge for header cells, so the value is recorded once, on row 1). Two full-width bold banner rows (Laboratory Assessments, Disease Assessment) are organizational headers carrying no marks.

schedule_properties.property_comment: Top header band naming the major study phases: 'Screening (up to 28 days before Day 1)' (cols 2-3), 'Treatment Phase' (cols 4-7), 'End of Treatment (EOT)' (col 8) and 'Post Treatment Follow-up Phase' (cols 9-11). Screening/Treatment/EOT/Follow-up are major study phases, hence epoch. The label column of the header block carries only the body-column heading 'Evaluation' (vertically merged across all three header rows), so the row label is empty and the property_name is synthesized.

Second header band subdividing the phases: 'Cycle 1' (cols 4-6) and 'Cycle 2 and Beyond' (col 7) under Treatment Phase, 'Safety follow-up Period' (cols 9-10) and 'Survival follow-up' (col 11) under Post Treatment Follow-up Phase. The band mixes treatment cycles with named follow-up periods, so it is typed period (sub-phases) rather than cycle. Cols 2-3 are blank here because the Screening cell of row 1 is merged vertically into this band; col 8 is blank. Label cell empty (see row 1), property_name synthesized.

Bottom header band giving the protocol day of each column with its visit window: D-28 to D-15, D-14 to D-1, D1 (±1), D8 (± 1), D15 (±1), D1 (± 2), and the relative-day follow-up timings (30/60/90 days after last IMPs admin, every 90 days after last safety follow-up). Protocol days relative to first dose or to last IMP administration, hence study_day; the ± windows are printed inline in the same cells rather than in a separate window row. Label cell empty (see row 1), property_name synthesized.
